title: How Finite-Rank Bottlenecks Shape the Low-Rank Adaptation Landscape
abstract: arXiv:2610.23343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pretrained models, yet theoretical explanations for why low-rank updates suffice remain incomplete. Most existing analyses rely on the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regime, which linearizes the network around the pretrained weights. In this work, we take a different approach that requires no linearization: our key observation is that, once the backbone is frozen, the loss sees each adapted weight matrix only through a finite-rank linear map induced by the frozen activations. Trace-norm regularization then forces the optimizer to pick a low-rank matrix among all matrices that produce the same observed output. This yields global minimizers whose ranks are controlled by the rank of this map, which we call the \emph{bottleneck rank}, rather than the sample size. translated_title: 有限秩瓶颈如何塑造低秩自适应的优化景观
translated_abstract: 低秩自适应（LoRA）已成为大型预训练模型参数高效微调的标准方法，然而对于为什么低秩更新就足够，现有理论解释仍不完整。大多数已有分析依赖于神经正切核（NTK）机制，即在预训练权重附近对网络进行线性化。在本工作中，我们采取了一种无需线性化的不同方法：我们的关键观察是，一旦主干网络被冻结，损失函数只能通过由冻结激活所诱导的有限秩线性映射来感知每个被适配的权重矩阵。迹范数正则化随后迫使优化器在所有产生相同观测输出的矩阵中选择一个低秩矩阵。这使得全局最优解的秩由该映射的秩（我们称之为“瓶颈秩”）控制，而非由样本量控制。对于多头注意力，我们通过利用两个代数性质获得了更紧的秩上界……
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需线性化的新理论框架，证明冻结主干后损失仅通过有限秩的“瓶颈”映射感知适配矩阵，因而迹范数正则化下的全局最优解秩由瓶颈秩而非样本量决定，从而解释了LoRA低秩更新为何足够有效。
en_tdlr: Without any linearization, this paper shows that freezing the backbone makes the loss see each adapted weight matrix only through a finite-rank bottleneck map, so trace-norm regularization yields global minimizers whose rank is governed by the bottleneck rank rather than the sample size, explaining why LoRA's low-rank updates suffice.
